en: The Section on Detailed Exposition, Chapter Ten:
The Convergence of the Mode of Synonyms.
Therein, what is the convergence of the mode of synonyms?
It is the verse: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range of right intention [is his pasture].”
“Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded”: mind, intellect, consciousness, the mind-faculty, the mind-base, cognizing, the state of having cognized—these are synonyms.
“Having right intention as his range”: intention of renunciation, intention of non-ill will, intention of non-cruelty—these are synonyms.

“Having right view as his foremost”: right view is called the sword of wisdom, the blade of wisdom, the jewel of wisdom, the lamp of wisdom, the goad of wisdom, the palace of wisdom—these are synonyms.
The application of synonyms as a method of exposition is concluded.
